jobs.title: Senior Learning Experience Designer
jobs.reason: This is a senior instructional/learning experience design role requiring specialist curriculum development, educational technology and design expertise — entirely off the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence profile. It is explicitly senior, demanding leadership, mentoring and end-to-end design experience the candidate lacks. London is offered, so location is fine, but field, skills and seniority all fail.
jobs.location: Any BBC location (London among Cardiff, Glasgow, Newcastle, Salford)

jobs.title: Senior International Safety and Compliance Officer (Maternity Cover)
jobs.reason: A "Senior" safety/compliance role requiring operational security and compliance expertise the candidate lacks, and the senior title implies substantial experience. Although the peacebuilding organisation is on-profile, this specific function is a poor fit and the seniority bar excludes it.

jobs.title: Chair of Trustees
jobs.reason: A Chair of Trustees is a senior governance/leadership position requiring extensive experience far beyond the candidate's stage. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Funding Manager
jobs.reason: Research funding administration is a strong field fit — the candidate's German Rectors' Conference experience (allocating €1.7m of funding to HEIs, managing documentation and stakeholders) maps directly onto grant-lifecycle management, and the Humanities/Social Sciences team is squarely on-profile. The "Manager" title and requirement for confident management of complex priorities and stakeholder trust imply a level of professional experience the candidate (student-assistant work only) cannot safely evidence, so it's a stretch rather than a clean entry-level fit. London-based, so the location filter is satisfied.

jobs.title: Associate Tutor - Philosophy
jobs.reason: This is a philosophy teaching post (Ethics of Technology/AI, Philosophy of AI) requiring demonstrated experience teaching philosophy and qualification to the corresponding award level — neither of which the candidate has, capping SKILLS. The subject is only adjacent to the candidate's IR/critical-theory background, and university teaching is not on-profile for an MSc-in-progress with no teaching experience.

jobs.title: Director, Insurance - London
jobs.reason: This is a senior Director-level credit analyst role in insurance ratings — pure financial/credit analysis with no connection to the candidate's IR/policy/risk profile. It requires 5+ years of experience (hard barrier), insurance financial statement analysis and accounting/actuarial qualifications the candidate lacks, plus desired Arabic. Multiple disqualifiers across field, skills and seniority.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, RL Scaling Science
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical ML research-engineering role requiring strong empirical reinforcement-learning research, large-scale distributed ML systems, and frontier-scale training experience — squarely the ML/software-engineering gap the candidate cannot substitute for (analysis-level Python only). It sits outside the policy/OSINT zone-c fit and far beyond the candidate's profile on both field and skills.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO and Chair
jobs.reason: This is an executive-assistant/administrative role unrelated to the candidate's IR research, policy or intelligence profile (FIELD mismatch). The deadline of Monday 22 June coincides with today's date and the function is off-profile, so this is a Low.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst

It also demands deep finance domain expertise the candidate lacks, and the "Senior" title with extensive transformation experience is far above their entry-level stage.

jobs.title: Social Impact Programme Coordinator

While the candidate's project-administration and funding-coordination experience is genuinely transferable, the work itself is not on-profile, and it leans toward events/community-engagement experience the candidate lacks.

The candidate lacks the essential social media publishing/optimisation experience, and the field is a clear mismatch for an LSE IR-research profile.

jobs.title: Associate Lecturer - Philosophy
jobs.reason: The role requires a PhD (or near-completion) in Philosophy, which the candidate does not hold — a hard ineligibility on both seniority and the PhD exclusion rule. It also demands HE teaching experience and specialist philosophy expertise (epistemology, metaphysics, philosophy of AI) outside the candidate's IR profile.

jobs.reason: This is a technical business-analyst role focused on API/data integration, BPMN process design and technical system delivery — entirely off the candidate's policy/research profile. It requires a recognised BA qualification (IIBA/BCS) or at least 5 years' practical BA experience as a hard essential, which the candidate fails, and the "Senior" title expects management/mentoring. Multiple exclusions apply (3+ years hard requirement, off-profile field).

jobs.title: Lecturer in War and Security (Teaching & Scholarship)
jobs.reason: War and Security is core to the candidate's IR/security profile, but the role explicitly requires a completed PhD and HE teaching experience — a hard ineligibility (candidate is MSc-in-progress). The Lecturer title and salary also signal a level well beyond entry.

jobs.title: Head of Research and Analysis
jobs.reason: IISS research on security and defence is core to the candidate's profile, but a "Head of" title requires substantial senior leadership and management experience the candidate (student/RA roles only) does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
